name: westwood_online_upgrade_api_init_state
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeApiInitState::Init validates the 100-byte WOL API bootstrap state block, copies the module handle into its provider fields, stores the bootstrap event, clears the two async event fields, and initializes three critical sections.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x42dda0 validates stdcall cleanup for three stack arguments, E_INVALIDARG for null self or structSize below 100 bytes, writes at offsets 0x04/0x08/0x0c for moduleHandle, offset 0x10 for bootstrapServerListEvent, zeros at offsets 0x14 and 0x18, imported InitializeCriticalSection calls for offsets 0x1c/0x34/0x4c, and S_OK on success.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_api_init_state_smoke verifies the null and too-small rejection paths, the successful field layout and value writes, and that all three embedded critical sections are usable through TryEnterCriticalSection before cleanup.
